note: One auto-update policy for everything Jovie runs. Prose: policy/UPDATE-POLICY.md. Repo rules are checked in every consumer by guards/plugins/auto-update.mjs (shadow until each consumer is clean). The inventory lists every part of the stack, how it updates today and the guard on it; status gap means it does not yet update itself on this policy. Seeded 2026-11-22 from reads of JovieInc/Jovie, JovieInc/ci, JovieInc/summer-config, Vercel and Supabase.

minor.note: A 0.x minor is a breaking release and is handled as a major.

major.autoMerge: after the compatibility check passes and the canary stays healthy

security.note: Security updates skip the release-age wait.

repoRules.updateConfig: Each repo has .github/dependabot.yml (or a Renovate config) covering every ecosystem it ships.
repoRules.cooldown: Each npm and pip entry that opens version PRs sets a cooldown (minimum release age).
repoRules.actionPins: Each third-party action is pinned to a full 40-character commit SHA with a version comment.
repoRules.autoMergeLane: Each repo has a workflow that lands Dependabot patch and minor PRs on green.
repoRules.holdExpiry: Each ignore (hold) carries a dated re-evaluate note or a Linear key; a dated hold older than maxHoldAgeDays is drift.
repoRules.nodeLts: The pinned Node major (.nvmrc or .node-version) is the current Active LTS major.
repoRules.wranglerCompat: A Cloudflare Worker's compatibility_date is no older than wranglerMaxAgeDays.
